name: Richard Atkins
headline: Managing Director, Oracle HCM & ERP, Kyte Consulting, Oracle ACE
position: Managing Director, Oracle HCM and ERP Practice
about:
I am a seasoned Consulting executive with 30+ years delivering innovative cloud solutions across global markets. Currently Managing Director of Oracle HCM & ERP at Kyte Consulting, leading business transformation initiatives for mid-market Australian enterprises.

• Built and scaled Oracle Cloud practice from startup to 90+ consultants at Certus Solutions (2012-2018)
• First UK partner to deliver Cloud HCM and integrated HCM/ERP
• Moved to Australia in 2018 as co-owner of Certus APAC and Head of Sales. Tripled Certus APAC revenue and team size, culminating in successful KPMG acquisition in 2021
• Joined Kyte Consulting in 2024 as Managing Director and Head of ERP and HCM and establishing Kyte as a go-to Oracle partner in ANZ.

Expertise:
Oracle Cloud HCM and ERP implementations | Solution Architecture |Business transformation | Practice development | Global project delivery across Financial Services, Government, Retail, Manufacturing, and Telecoms

I am passionate about helping organizations achieve 100% project success through proven methodologies and deep Oracle expertise.

My experience and regular contributions to the Oracle Cloud community, resulted in my being awarded the accolade of Oracle ACE in 2016, I regularly speak at conferences, user groups and via Webinars on Oracle Cloud and I am widely recognised as a leading expert in my field.
